description: Fork of exp593 (1.4337 SoTA). SINGLE module change: v_lut NAP 6 -> 5, tph 320 -> 512. K halves (64 -> 32), tph 1.6x (320 -> 512). Atom count drops 20% (122K -> 98K), atom width unchanged (64), mixture depth +60% (320 -> 512), per-row gradient coverage doubles (128 -> 256 tokens/row at bs=16). v_lut params 7.86M -> 6.29M per layer (-9.44M total). Bandwidth +14.1 Mbits trunk. Combines two of exp593's NAP=5 read_out winning axes (denser coverage + boosted depth). Tests whether v_lut's structural position (feeds SDPA, no per-layer compounding) lets it absorb NAP cut better than out_proj did (exp594 lost +0.018). Total ~251.66M params, ~169 Mbits trunk, ~572 Mbits total.
